diamond_chef_meal_and_fire_speed_multipl.expression: (() => { const map = idleon.getDNSM("AlchBubbles").h; const value = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map, "MealSpdz") ? map["MealSpdz"] : 0; return value === null || typeof value !== "number" ? value : Math.max(1, value); })()

daily_drip_final_bonus.expression: (() => { const raw = Number(idleon.getDNSM("AlchBubbles").h.LqdCap); const alchemyLevel = Number(idleon.getAttr("PixelHelperActor")[5].behaviors.getBehavior("ActorEvents_232")._GenINFO[87]); return raw * Math.max(Math.pow(alchemyLevel / 25, 0.3), 0); })()

y13_final_bonus.expression: (() => { const map = idleon.getDNSM("AlchBubbles").h; return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map, "Y13") ? map["Y13"] : 0; })()

diamond_chef_meal_count.expression: (() => { const meals = idleon.getAttr("Meals")[0]; return meals.reduce((count, level) => count + (Number(level) >= 11 ? 1 : 0), 0); })()

cropius_mapper_portal_count.expression: (() => { const players = idleon.getAttr("PlayerDATABASE").h; let opened = 0; Object.keys(players).forEach(id => { for (let i = 0; i < 13; i++) opened += Number(players[id].h.KillsLeft2Advance[251 + i][0]) < 1 ? 1 : 0; }); return opened; })()

player_alchemy_max_hp.expression: (() => { const script = idleon.allScripts.ActorEvents_12; const original = script._customBlock_PlayerHPmax; let calls = 0; let maximumHP; try { script._customBlock_PlayerHPmax = function(...args) { calls++; maximumHP = original.apply(this, args); return maximumHP; }; idleon.callFunction('TalentCalc', -2); } finally { script._customBlock_PlayerHPmax = original; } if (calls !== 1 || script._customBlock_PlayerHPmax !== original) throw new Error('Alchemy HP capture must intercept exactly one call and restore PlayerHPmax'); return maximumHP; })()

player_alchemy_max_mp.expression: (() => { const script = idleon.allScripts.ActorEvents_12; const original = script._customBlock_PlayerMPmax; let calls = 0; let maximumMP; try { script._customBlock_PlayerMPmax = function(...args) { calls++; maximumMP = original.apply(this, args); return maximumMP; }; idleon.callFunction('TalentCalc', -2); } finally { script._customBlock_PlayerMPmax = original; } if (calls !== 1 || script._customBlock_PlayerMPmax !== original) throw new Error('Alchemy MP capture must intercept exactly one call and restore PlayerMPmax'); return maximumMP; })()
